ignoreCommand: if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" 2>/dev/null; then if git diff --name-only "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD | grep -q '^public/'; then echo 'building: public/ assets changed'; exit 1; fi; if git diff --name-only "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD | grep -vE '^(docs/|\.zcode/)' | grep -vE '\.(md|mdx)$' | grep -q .; then echo 'building: application-affecting changes present'; exit 1; else echo 'skipping build: documentation-only change'; exit 0; fi; else echo 'building: no reachable previous commit'; exit 1; fi
